shortDescription: Create, read, and update a Linode PostgreSQL database.

options.name: allow_list
options.description: A list of IP addresses and CIDR ranges that can access the Managed Database.

options.name: cluster_size
options.description: The number of Linode instance nodes deployed to the Managed Database.

options.name: detach_private_network
options.description: If true, the Managed Database will be detached from its current private network when `private_network` is null. If the Managed Database is not currently attached to a private network or the private_network field is specified, this option has no effect. This is not necessary when switching between VPC subnets.

options.name: engine
options.description: The Managed Database engine in engine/version format.

options.name: engine_config
options.description: Various parameters used to configure this database's underlying engine. NOTE: If a configuration parameter is not current accepted by this field, configure using the linode.cloud.api_request module.

options.name: fork
options.description: Information about a database to fork from.

options.name: label
options.description: The label of the Managed Database.

options.name: private_network
options.description: Restricts access to this database using a virtual private cloud (VPC) that you've configured in the region where the database will live.

options.name: region
options.description: The region of the Managed Database.

options.name: state
options.description: The desired state of the Managed Database.

options.name: type
options.description: The Linode Instance type used by the Managed Database for its nodes.

options.name: updates
options.description: Configuration settings for automated patch update maintenance for the Managed Database.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: The maximum number of seconds a poll operation can take before raising an error.
